Time: 3 min. Teaching intent: Retrieve prior knowledge before revealing the method.
Talk track: Can two 80 µm labels be treated as identical?
Expected answer / misconception: No. First match their definitions, reference, direction, and temperature.
Visual: The three conditions identify what must be compared.
[Sources]
R6: NIST, Credibility Consideration for Digital Twins | https://www.nist.gov/publications/credibility-consideration-digital-twins-manufacturing
R8: IEEE TCPMT, Simulation and Experimental Study of Fan-Out Warpage | https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/8590768

Time: 4 min. Teaching intent: Teach the mechanism or design rule.
Talk track: Peak-to-valley, center-to-edge, and curvature are different summaries; specify sign and reference plane. Trace the visual in order: datum; displacement field; reported metric. Connect this mechanism to the worked example: A synthetic +80 µm center-to-edge value and 80 µm peak-to-valley value need not describe the same shape. Boundary: The 80 µm values are synthetic teaching data.
Expected answer / misconception: Ask students to explain the link between adjacent elements; a conceptual diagram is not a measurement.
Visual: Native diagram encodes the causal or design relationship.
[Sources]
R6: NIST, Credibility Consideration for Digital Twins | https://www.nist.gov/publications/credibility-consideration-digital-twins-manufacturing
R8: IEEE TCPMT, Simulation and Experimental Study of Fan-Out Warpage | https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/8590768

Time: 4 min. Teaching intent: Work the example step by step.
Talk track: Set up the case: A synthetic +80 µm center-to-edge value and 80 µm peak-to-valley value need not describe the same shape. Identify the starting information, state the reasoning step aloud, then ask what observation would check the conclusion. Stop before the next slide's question is answered.
Expected answer / misconception: Students must identify the input, the inference, and the check. The 80 µm values are synthetic teaching data.
Visual: Three-part reasoning path separates the example from its verification.
